value.rationale: Smallest-period non-single-minus attracting eye behavior is a motivated unresolved explicit existence problem in the PLPDM family, distinct from the paper’s illustrated period-five eyes. Two disjoint uniform positive-area windows and exact sharp boundaries within the chosen chart provide a new usable phase-region calculation. Example b=4/5 lies below the prime-two attracting cutoff sqrt(3)/2, showing a nontrivial period-selective distinction.
